rationale.conceptual: Reproducing the exact steady oscillating solution is a straightforward evaluation of an analytically given complex function. All formulas are explicitly written out in the paper (Eq. 20–25), and no derivation or modification is needed. This is a textbook operation.
rationale.execution: The workflow consists of only three sequential evaluations of the same analytic function with different parameter sets, each generating a single CSV. No external tooling, data fetching, or multi‑stage orchestration is required. A single short script suffices.

difficulty.reasoning: The task is to implement a fully-specified analytic formula from the paper using NumPy, producing three small CSV files. No novel method, deep domain understanding, or complex pipeline is required.
